coaching.headline: All six won fights were cashed, and the team took every Fangtooth, the Orb Prime and nine structures despite sixteen Sparrow and Narbash deaths.

flags.text: Sparrow carried the damn damage: 15 kills, 35381 hero damage and 30126 objective damage, all game highs.
Gadget never died: first blood on Lt. Belica among ten kills, including the last two allied kills.
Narbash died eight times, a hell of a tax: six to Murdock and five on the duo lane.
Eight Sparrow deaths, almost twice the norm: Serath scored four, The Fey three, Murdock one.

focus.title: Keep converting, stop bleeding the duo
focus.action: Repeat the conversion: a tower or objective straight after each won fight. On the duo lane, Narbash and Sparrow trade only with Khaimera or Gadget close enough to follow, and reset when Serath is missing.

25.4.call: Sparrow killed Lt. Belica on mid as the enemy mid outer fell, then Gadget and Khaimera won the allied-jungle follow-up three kills to two while the allied duo inner fell. When both duo players are down with the duo inner exposed, call one answer before chasing kills: defend the inner or take the next objective.

27.6.call: Fangtooth went allied, Narbash and Gideon died first in the enemy jungle, and Sparrow answered with three kills before Gadget finished Lt. Belica. The enemy offlane and mid inners fell next, then both inhibitors. Sound conversion.

30.5.call: After Orb Prime went allied, Khaimera killed Serath and Gadget killed Scarlett and The Fey in the enemy base, then Khaimera took the Core. Ending straight off the Prime take is the right call.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Never died: ten kills, ten assists, 8.6 CS per minute on a 5.4 norm. Between fights, keep that farm pace; zero deaths is the standard.
The duo-lane kill on Serath came shortly after Narbash fell there, and the enemy mid outer dropped soon after. When the duo lane loses a body, make the same trip.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Finished the enemy mid inner, the mid inhibitor and the Core, with a game-high 14 assists. Whenever an inhibitor falls, keep calling the next structure straight away.
Died last in the duo-lane fight lost 2-3, after Sparrow and Narbash, and the allied mid outer fell soon after. When both duo players are already down, back off instead.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Six kills on Murdock, plus three kills in seconds in the enemy jungle after the third allied Fangtooth. Keep taking jungle fights whenever Gadget can follow up.
One death came seconds after a duo-lane kill on The Fey, to Serath. After landing a kill while Serath is unseen, step back toward Narbash before chasing the next target.
36755a7d-74d7-4fda-b2b5-a03f1efdfa34: Ten wards against 5 for The Fey, 12594 healing and 31853 damage mitigated, with no death before minute ten. Keep the ward lead whenever the duo lane is contested.
Died first in two fights; a death to Serath on the offlane came outside any detected fight. Before leaving the duo lane, call the route and move with Khaimera.
56742da0-50f6-4271-b235-d4ebd3e47c5a: A mid kill on Serath before the offlane opened, then razed the enemy offlane outer, the team's first structure. When the offlane is quiet early, repeat the mid trip.
Hero damage at 380 per minute on a 701 norm, one kill, zero assists. Once the enemy offlane outer is down, bring Black Hole to the next mid fight.

matchup: Lt. Belica was the lane opponent: Gadget killed Lt. Belica three times, including first blood, and never died to Lt. Belica.
Lt. Belica's Seismic Assault stuns and Neural Disruptor silences, the two crowd-control threats on mid.
Lt. Belica's Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage, trimming Soulbearer's magical lifesteal.
build: Soulbinder and Azure Core are two of three winning-core items; Entropy is missing.
Soulbinder: long-range ability hits on heroes deal bonus damage and, on a short cooldown, grant permanent magical power.
Combustion, finished last, splashes ability damage onto nearby enemies; earlier fights ran without Combustion.
eternal: Vesh turns a share of ability damage on heroes into damage over time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage to the major.
Lotus and Demiurge lead a toss-up in the Gadget mid field; Vesh, the most played, ranks well behind both.
Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair; the Tithe of Death pairing run here is the most played.
augment: Auto-Lock Amp makes the Seek and Destroy drone home in faster.
Auto-Lock Amp clearly leads the Gadget mid augment field, ahead of Blast Zone. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active grants a shield plus magical lifesteal and extra movement speed briefly.
Soulbearer is the clear best Gadget mid crest, ahead of the most played Epoch. Sound keep.
improvement: Lotus over Vesh is the field-backed draft change: random stat gains over time and on takedowns, giving up the damage over time.
Keeping Vesh, swap Tithe of Death for Lich, the best pair's slot: level-scaled magical lifesteal replaces takedown mana and haste.

matchup: Serath was the jungle opponent: 5/8/5, with Khaimera ahead on gold, 15477 to 13010.
All five Serath kills landed on Sparrow or Narbash, so cover the duo when Serath goes missing.
Four enemies built Tainted items, so hits on Khaimera briefly cut Invigorate and Draconum healing.
build: Overlord and Draconum are two of three winning-core items; Rapture is missing.
Sky Splitter's basic attacks deal a share of current health, strong into Scarlett, the enemy's top mitigator.
Draconum raises healing while damaging heroes or monsters and restores health on takedowns.
eternal: Lotus grants a random gain every two minutes and on takedowns; Early Bloom adds an extra level at level twelve.
Lotus leans first in the Khaimera jungle field, ahead of Satariel. Sound keep.
Masterpiece with Prima Donna is the best and most played Lotus pair; Early Bloom with Immaculate ranks behind.
augment: Jungle Invasion grants level-scaled physical power inside any jungle, twice as much in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion clearly leads the Khaimera jungle augment field over Feral Ambush. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's active deals area damage and heals on the first hero hit, at half effect on further hero hits.
Eviscerator is the clear best Khaimera jungle crest; Judgement, the second most played, ranks well behind.
improvement: Swap Judgement for Eviscerator, the field's clear best: a burst of attack speed, omnivamp and on-hit damage replaces the area heal.
Eviscerator evolves from Sharpshooter Crest and Judgement from Champion Crest, so the change starts at the first crest buy.
Masterpiece with Prima Donna trades Early Bloom and Immaculate for kill-stacking damage, more hero damage and more damage taken.

matchup: Duo was Sparrow and Narbash against Murdock and The Fey; neither duo lost a player before minute ten.
Sparrow killed Murdock six times; Murdock killed Sparrow once, while Serath scored the most kills on Sparrow.
Murdock's Static Trap roots, and Serath's Heaven's Fury dashes onto a target while immune to crowd control.
build: Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter and Spectra, the full winning core, are all missing.
Tainted Rounds cuts the target's healing on basic attacks, useful against Serath's 13918 healing.
Terminus, finished last, turns lifesteal overheal into a shield; earlier fights ran without Terminus.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage projectiles on hitting a low-health hero; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after leaving Heightened Senses stealth.
Thraex leans ahead of Weald in the Sparrow carry field; Forage with Wind-Rider, run here, is the best Weald pair.
augment: Endless Hunt resets basic ability cooldowns on takedowns and adds permanent physical penetration.
Sun Shards leans ahead of Endless Hunt in the Sparrow carry augment field.
crest: Pacifier's active is a short dash plus an empowered next physical hit, boosted against low-health targets and recastable after hero kills.
Pacifier is the clear best Sparrow carry crest. Sound keep.
improvement: Sun Shards over Endless Hunt is the field lean: ricocheting basic attacks with partial on-hit effects instead of takedown cooldown resets.
Thraex for Weald is the field lean: the marked hero takes more damage and deals less back, giving up Weald's projectiles.

matchup: The Fey out-earned Narbash 15283 gold to 12006 and dealt 28823 hero damage, the enemy team's most.
The Fey's Fly Trap pulls and stuns and Bramble Patch slows, the enemy support's crowd control.
Thunk stuns, and Crash Bang Boom! stacks slows into a mesmerize before a final knock-up stun.
build: Truesilver Bracelet is one of three winning-core items; Crystal Tear and Dynamo are missing.
Truesilver Bracelet shields Narbash after the ultimate cast, with crowd-control immunity while the shield holds.
Xenia shields nearby allied heroes, and Everbloom adds mitigation and tenacity to allies Narbash heals or shields.
eternal: Exarch gives healed or shielded allies attack speed and bonus magical on-hit damage for a short window.
Exarch and Lotus are a toss-up in the Narbash support field; Preservation with Delayed Fate is the best Exarch pair.
Preservation with Omnipresent, run here, is the most played Exarch pair.
augment: Percussive Tear makes each Crash Bang Boom! hit shred armor briefly.
Thonk and Percussive Tear are a toss-up in the Narbash support augment field. Sound keep.
crest: Sanctification's active shields Narbash and nearby heroes with tenacity while the shield holds; the passive raises the ward cap.
Reclamation and Rift Walkers lead a toss-up in the Narbash support field; Sanctification, the most played, ranks behind both.
improvement: Delayed Fate for Omnipresent matches the best Exarch pair: part of ability damage taken spreads over time, giving up out-of-combat speed.
Reclamation leads the crest toss-up: a cleanse for Narbash and nearby allies in place of the team shield.

matchup: Scarlett was the lane opponent: 2/4/3, and neither offlaner killed the other.
Both Gideon deaths came to Lt. Belica, inside the duo-lane and enemy-jungle fights.
Scarlett's Swan Song restrains a target and makes Scarlett unstoppable for the duration.
build: Combustion and Noxia are two of three winning-core items; Azure Core is missing and Megacosm is off-meta.
Megacosm burns a share of max health on ability hits, plus bonus-health damage on heroes.
Noxia, finished last, adds max-health damage when a second ability hits a marked hero; earlier fights lacked Noxia.
eternal: Vesh adds damage over time from ability hits on heroes; Phylactery speeds cooldowns and shields after the ultimate.
Thraex is the clear best in the small Gideon offlane field; Vesh, the most played, ranks second.
Tithe of Death with Phylactery, run here, is the best Vesh pair.
augment: Infinite Impact gives Void Breach infinite range.
Infinite Impact clearly leads the Gideon offlane augment field over Event Horizon. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer pairs a shield with magical lifesteal and bonus speed on activation.
Typhoon leans ahead of Soulbearer in the Gideon offlane crest field.
improvement: Typhoon for Soulbearer is the field lean: basic attacks stack attack speed into a short dash, giving up the shield and lifesteal.
Typhoon starts from Warlock Crest and Soulbearer from Wizard Crest, so the change begins at the first crest buy.
Thraex with The King and Ferocity is the clear field pick, trading Vesh's ability burn for a basic-attack mark.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: The Fey. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Narbash) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
ourKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
ourKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
ourKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

ourKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
ourKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
enemyKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her
